_comment: Ready-made security hooks. Copy the entries you want into .claude/settings.json (or a plugin's hooks/hooks.json) and review in /hooks. Paths assume this skill dir; adjust as needed.

hooks.description: Append the config change to ~/.claude/security-audit.log (compliance audit trail)

hooks.prompt: Does this Bash command destructively delete data, disable security controls, or exfiltrate secrets (e.g. rm -rf on broad paths, chmod 777, curl|sh, history rewrite, credential reads piped to network)? Answer yes only if it is clearly dangerous and should be blocked.
hooks.description: Flag destructive/exfiltrating shell commands before they run

hooks.prompt: Is this write targeting a sensitive file that should not be created or modified casually — credentials (.env, *.pem, *.key), or business/financial data (financials, pricing, contracts, activity logs)? Answer yes only if the path clearly matches one of those.
hooks.description: Warn on writes to credential or sensitive-business file paths
OPTIONAL: POST a session-end security event to a webhook/SIEM. Replace the URL to enable; left as example.invalid so it is inert by default.
